acceptance_rule: Each candidate/F4 is accepted only when its paired point and CI95 lower are positive within every requested trial, with exact consumer outputs, full-model gradient/update fingerprints and actual native/backward execution paths. Three complete arms, all blocks retained; one trial is exploratory. Tile/gather comparison is secondary. No combined candidate, no historical C/R target.
limitation: Fixed synthetic inputs and this configuration only; no long-term convergence claim.
